historical_reviews.deepseek: Generic evidence is insufficient for a two-ended fabric event.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly requires link-pair mapping and both targeted/all-device decode, yet engineering must resolve the contradictory threshold field and Script identity.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Row121 exceeds a memory-page threshold; XGMI BER is a link reliability threshold and requires endpoint-pair evidence at both sides.
historical_reviews.v3_1: A cross-socket BER event must bind injection and decoded records to both actual endpoints and prove a defined BER threshold transition, not just any corrected link record.

original_test_intent: Inject one approved XGMI BER-threshold event on a mapped cross-socket link pair, decode the fresh corrected records at the responsible endpoint(s) and fleet view, and prove bounded link recovery without fabric or workload degradation.
original_method: Resolve block/subblock/method/type and Script identity; map device0 injection, device2 decode and both socket/AID/link endpoints to stable UUID/BDFs; baseline link BER counters and decoded-record cursors on both ends; inject once; correlate the exact pair, threshold transition and corrected records; verify link width/state/traffic/peer health, then restore RAS/debug state without retry.
manual_activity: The XGMI/platform owner maps both physical endpoints and device IDs, defines the BER threshold and decoded-field oracle, approves one injection and supervises fabric recovery.
required_inputs: Approved amdgpuras build/version/checksum and full AMD GPU RAS guide table6.7
Proof block7/subblock1/method6/type2 is XGMI BER Exceeded and reconciliation with the UMC CRC replay Script name
Stable UUID/BDF/OAM/socket/AID/link map explaining injection device0 and decoder device2
Current-platform replacement or validation for sample Socket7-to-Socket0 pair
BER threshold, starting counter, injection magnitude, expected counter/threshold transition and meaning of `exceed_err_threshold`
Expected per-endpoint and all-device decoded fields, deduplication/record correlation and freshness
Traffic/link containment limits, independent OOB recovery, aborts and restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated idle multi-socket fabric with console/OOB and reversible workload/data validation
Do not inject until both endpoints and device IDs are proven from authoritative topology
Preserve BER/link counters, decode cursors and logs without clearing; do not reload shared driver without approval
One mapped link event once; abort on wrong pair, uncorrected/fatal escalation, link down/retrain storm, peer loss, data error or host instability
Never retry automatically; preserve both-end evidence and use owner-approved fabric recovery
agent_execution_scope: Validate tool/guide, tuple, endpoint/device mapping, BER baseline, traffic and recovery readiness
After separate approval, collect one injection plus device2/all-device decode and both-end link evidence
Do not choose endpoints, assume sample sockets, modify thresholds, reload driver, inject, clear, retrain/reset, retry, recover or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve pair, tuple, BER transition and record correlation oracle
Supervise one cross-socket injection and containment
Restore link/fabric, validate all peers/workloads and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: High-level fit only; it omits the literal tuple, asymmetric devices and two-ended BER threshold correlation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After resolution, run the approved explicit link-pair equivalent of block7/subblock1/method6/type2/device0 once, then decode the designated endpoint and all devices, correlating both sides.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: modprobe, device0 UMC query, injection tuple/device0, device2 and all-device decode, Socket7-Socket0 sample, table6.7 corrected record, UMC CRC Script and 30/30-minute scope remain disputed inputs.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create one quantified BER threshold event on a fully mapped cross-socket pair and validate fresh correlated corrected records plus stable fabric traffic on both endpoints.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authoritative pair mapping, BER arithmetic, threshold-field reconciliation, two-ended freshness/correlation and fabric health recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A corrected record with threshold flag0 cannot by itself prove BER Exceeded, and device2 output cannot be attributed to device0's link without topology proof.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A link fault can affect both sockets and several devices; in-band views may diverge or disappear during retraining.

project_override_considerations: Sample Socket7/Socket0, OAM0, record_id and registers are run-specific. The project must explain whether `exceed_err_threshold:0` is expected encoding or copied/non-threshold evidence and whether the UMC CRC Script actually implements XGMI injection.
expected_evidence: Resolved tuple/Script/threshold semantics and tool/guide provenance
Both-end UUID/BDF/OAM/socket/AID/link map explaining device0 and device2 roles
Baseline BER/link counters, width/state, decode cursors, logs, traffic/data health and OOB readiness
Exact one-shot transcript naming the approved link pair and quantified BER transition
Fresh correlated device-specific and all-device corrected/CMC table6.7 records at intended endpoints, including threshold field explanation
No fatal escalation or lasting link/peer/workload impact; recovery/restoration diff and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Injection uses device0 while targeted decode uses device2; the source does not map their relationship. The Script name is UMC CRC replay rather than XGMI BER. Criteria numbering is stale, and the claimed BER Exceeded sample has `exceed_err_threshold:0`.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The XGMI BER intent and candidate tuple are identifiable. Engineering can resolve topology and threshold semantics before execution, so static review completes.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row122 Wistron-GPU RAS-00023-V003: prove block7/subblock1/method6/type2/device0 is XGMI BER Exceeded and reconcile the UMC CRC Script; map injection device0, decoder device2 and both UUID/BDF/OAM/socket/AID/link endpoints; validate or replace Socket7-to-Socket0 sample; define BER baseline/threshold/injection magnitude and explain `exceed_err_threshold:0`; approve device/all-device record correlation, link/traffic limits, aborts, recovery and restoration.

review_improvement: Adds two-ended topology and BER arithmetic while surfacing the threshold flag and Script/component contradictions missed by prior reviews.
independent_technical_reasoning: XGMI errors belong to a link pair, so neither a source-device command nor one decoder record is meaningful without mapping both endpoints. 'BER Exceeded' implies a measurable boundary; a sample field showing zero requires authoritative interpretation. A corrected record may reflect containment, but the fabric must also retain stable peer communication and data integrity.
